title: GoryHub
features:
Visuals (ESP):
Door ESP — Highlights the next door and displays its number.

Key & Lever ESP — Never miss a key or lever in dark rooms again.

Item ESP — Highlights useful loot: Lighters, Vitamins, Crucifixes, etc. (sometimes it may not work)

Monster ESP — Shows entities (Rush, Ambush, Figure) through walls.

Closet ESP — Shows hiding spots (Closets).

Book/Fuses ESP — Shows all books/fuses at Door 50/100.

Player Enhancements:
Fullbright — Disables darkness. Everything is crystal clear!

Speed — Adjustable walk speed (16-21).

FOV Changer — Custom field of view for better visibility.

Notifications:
Monster Notifications — Receive an notification the moment a monster spawns.
